page.overview:
Who is Spring Forward?

Spring Forward shares her design, coat color, and sometimes cutie mark with "Berry Icicle", shares her design and sometimes cutie mark with Golden Harvest, "Maroon Carrot", "Serena", S01E11 Unnamed Earth Mare #4, and S01E11 Unnamed Earth Mare #5, shares her design with Daisy and Caramel Apple, shares her mane and tail style with Strawberry Sunrise, and shares her tail style with Lemon Hearts and Twinkleshine.

Spring Forward appears in The Mysterious Mare Do Well admiring Mare Do Well's heroism, during Becoming Popular (The Pony Everypony Should Know) in Sweet and Elite, and at both wedding ceremonies in A Canterlot Wedding - Part 2.

Spring Forward appears at Twilight Sparkle's princess coronation in Magical Mystery Cure.

Spring Forward decorates Canterlot for the Summer Sun Celebration in Princess Twilight Sparkle - Part 1 and appears in the auditorium at the end of Twilight's Kingdom - Part 1.
